text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-t-a-g-e-d a n-u-r-s-e a-n-d d-o-c-t-o-r a-g-r-e-e-d t-o c-o-o-p-e-r-a-t-e i-n t-h-e s-c-h-e-m-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a f-a-l-s-e c-l-a-i-m i-n t-h-e f-i-l-e s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-e-d t-h-e c-o-w-o-r-k-e-r o-n t-h-e s-t-o-r-y, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d n-a-r-r-a-t-i-v-e t-h-a-t i-s n-o-w i-n t-h-e h-e-a-r-t a-n-d l-o-g s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t c-o-r-r-o-b-o-r-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d t-h-e r-e-c-o-r-d-s t-o f-a-l-s-i-f-y t-h-e i-n-j-u-r-y, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-a-m-p-e-r-e-d f-i-l-e i-n t-h-e r-e-c-o-r-d-s a-n-d d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d t-h-e f-a-l-s-e c-l-a-i-m f-o-r p-a-y-m-e-n-t, g-e-n-e-r-a-t-i-n-g a p-r-o-c-e-s-s e-d c-l-a-i-m a-n-d a p-r-o-c-e-s-s e-d c-l-a-i-m i-n t-h-e s-y-s-t-e-m w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e i-n-i-t-i-a-l f-r-a-u-d d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n s-c-r-e-e-n.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-v-a-d-e-d t-h-e i-n-v-e-s-t-i-g-a-t-i-o-n b-y a-d-h-e-r-i-n-g t-o t-h-e s-t-o-r-y, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-o-h-e-r-e-n-t b-u-t f-a-l-s-e n-a-r-r-a-t-i-v-e i-n t-h-e f-i-l-e s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e c-r-o-s-s c-h-e-c-k o-f t-h-e o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l d-o-c-t-o-r n-o-t-e-s.
